notes.title: Patch #V 1.1.2
notes.notes:
V 1.1.2

New features

 Item rewards for quests.
 Notification added for quest items.
 Time of Day widget, Sun icon defines when sun is up, Moon icon defines night time.


Changes

 Exp notification gains are clearly separated now.


Fixes

 Exp notification alignments when harvesting or earning exp was off.
 Junk plant fiber gave berries on harvest.

notes.title: Patch #V 1.1.1
notes.notes:
New features

 Added inventory shortcuts tooltip.


Changes

 New Plant fiber mesh and icons.
 Plant fiber bushes added near deep water areas.
 Plant fiber now takes 1x2 inventory space.


Fixes

 Fixed Mission markers error if player loaded save game near active mission objective
 Quick move didn't stack items. Moving items into  inventory or into containers, will try to search for an existing item stack first.
 Deer on death, casted Zombie sound
 Deer on dismemberment, generated zombie limbs

notes.title: Patch #V 1.1.0
notes.notes:
New features

 Friendly AI faces now players if they are close by.
 Basic swimming system.
 Hardened Wood upgrade tier added.
 Farming system. Plants require sky light and water.
 Seed vendor added.
 Locations display notifications to users, regarding where they are.
 Fuel items return leftovers.
 New AI Spawn system. Can earn extra level Exp if the whole area is cleared.
 Third person FOV slider.
 Map displays Point of interest.



Changes

 Refactored sky logic, 7x more stars in sky material, without performance changes.
 Re-wrote existing water planes, to support swimming.
 Modified Movement logic. Running and stamina have more uses now.
 Regular wood house build parts cost 2x less resources & are crafted 2x faster at inventory
 Dynamic AI speed. AI decides now itself if they will run or walk based on their stamina.
 Dead AI will emit particles, making it easier to find corpses in the grass.
 Harvesting zombies fully, dismembers it now.
 Crafting menus are now grid based, a bit faster to find required items.
 Jumping requires stamina now.
 Disabled first person view currently, until first person hit logic is unified.
 Selecting place option for build parts, closes inventory.


Performance

 New core AI logic, all AI controller logic is now executed only if they are rendered, reducing CPU usage.
 Optimized terrain logic, reduces CPU usage. 
 Optimized terrain materials, less draw calls, reduces CPU usage.


previously CPU load was 85% now 45%. - tested on i7 6700k


Fixes

 2nd foliage was destroyed if it was too close to the one, which was harvested.
 Campfire wasn't saved correctly.
 Was possible to break ADS if the sprint was spammed.
 Gun fire was not stopped, when the player died, until the clip was empty.
 Item Equip sounds were not always played.
 Weapon slots were not loaded correctly from save game.
 Directional light caused water shading artifacts.
 On death AI widgets remained on screen
 Equipping weapons directly which was taken from the corpse, didn't add correct exp and damage information was not shown.
 Some trees were also removed when grass density was changed under graphic settings.
 Was possible to complete kill quests with a single kill if the player shot dead body multiple times.
 AI Got stuck after target was out of LOS
 AI got stuck when it tried to climb or jump down
And many more fixes. 



Networking

 Changed AI behavior, AI now searches for the closest target. Required change for multiplayer.
 Multiplayer mission sharing was fixed, previously all objects were shared between players, now objects have their own interaction database.

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Fixes
[olist]
 Loading save game, crashed the engine.
Added unit tests, so it won't happen again.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Changes
[olist]
 New game day and night time calculation logic refactored. Now New game starts with a certain daytime between 8 am - 5 pm.
 Improved AI reaction timings
 New save game logic, Steam user Id is used for save files now on. Will have an impact on previous save games.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 AI always focused on lost targets, while searching
 Crash when AI combat ended and re-spawn was triggered instantly.
 AI audio and animations played after death sometimes.
 Hellfire females had male death sounds
 Item un-hold wasn't triggered, when selecting an empty quick slot.
 Hammer won't hit objects any more, if upgrading them.
 Changing mouse sensitivity, didn't modify up/down axis speed.
 The Crafting list was not cleared on death.
 Bed respawn points were not saved.
 Cull distance fix for starting temple. It had a huge mesh pop-in.
[/olist]

Networking
[olist]
 Fixed Mission interaction in multiplayer - correct player is rewarded now with mission progression
 Fixed skill exp gain in multiplayer - correct player is rewarded with survival exp now.
 Out of ammo sound wasn't played on the client side.
 Moved AI sounds to the server side.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.19
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Crafting items at player inventory, awards with Survival Exp.
 Keys system
Some entrances require Key items to be accessed.
Example:
Outpost doors may require a keycard.
Cave walls may require artifacts.
If an item exists in the inventory, the area can be accessed..
When a key is lost inside an area which requires a key, there is a panel button, which opens that door again.
 Added interactable keyboards, which may open up secret storages or access locations.
 Added light boxes, which react to player movement. Used to light up glass boxes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/296dd1a14f1d1601a4f4d45253fd37016566af48.jpg

 Added Ancient Asteroidium hammer
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Added bloody textures for bones.
 Changed metallic floor textures aren't that reflective any more.
 Created new animation for axe attack
 Changed Inventory interface design.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Small Leather pouch Uncommon/Common/Rare had T3 backpack grids.
 Fixed Pouches cell vertical calculation. Inventory Grids should be rendered correctly now
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.18
notes.notes:
NB:Existing save games may be broken, cause previously Max stats information wasn't saved down.

New features
[olist]
 AI kill statistics is counted and displayed under stats interface.
 Survival and Combat perks system.
Player level isn't tied with perk level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/7092cb25b40556cb5ea9486c4ebe3788a255cd6c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/91f07feda5708d57199f963ce8fab038be9de898.jpg

Changes
[olist]
 Roamer attack types are executed at random order.

Fixes
[olist]
 Was possible to place beds on top of each other.
 Sometimes dropped container inventory broke and cells weren't rendered.
 Items loading stopped from loading the game after 99th save.
 Was not possible to see build grids at night.

Optimization
[olist]
 Improved build part placement performance.

[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.17
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Added dust particles into large ruin areas.
 Added Asteroid particles.
 Added Blood toxicity survival stat.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/d60ef20d612af2f7483ffd8d18d2e4bfe17fe061.png
Blood toxicity is increased if you consume items (water, food etc..).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/ee65742488019e0b75c72e814c9691d6650c9d30.png
Some items may decrease blood toxicity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/c0cce58030d33eab76b0f088fed2c08787243b76.png
When your blood toxicity reaches 10,000 , you will die.
Drinking from a muddy water plane gives you more blood toxicity than a clean water plane, therefore you must check which textured water it is, before you drink. 
Overall blood toxicity level can be monitored under the stats page.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/8e68db8075f6bb5246d04a25028a9f238ffd4ae3.png
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Added actual night length at new game HUD.
 Revamped World item info display,
 Removed World item green / red colors, was hard to see them on some item grades. Items at inventory still display colors based on if those stats are good (green) or bad (red)
 Items display now at front of value - or + depending if they increase or decrease that stat. 
 Mutant hunters have more human-like textures now.
 Cooked meat decreases thirst value now.
 Increased Apples length till decay.
 Removed silver requirement from healium berries drink
 Healium berries require a bottle of water. 
 Harvesting epic berries may also return plant fiber now.
 Junk bandages can be stacked now, up to 3 per stack.
[/olist]

Fixes
If player died through consumable items, Exp and level wasn't saved
If player died through consumable items, death sound wasn't played.
Eating raw meat didn't play a consuming sound.

Optimization
[olist]
 Refactored inventory item details display logic.
 Moved Dust FX over Niagara system.
 Moved Asteroids FX over Niagara system.
 Added max texture resolution parameters for scrap metal weapons. (may impact visuals).
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.16
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Support for Multi-level totem challenges.
Some totems may have more than 1 wave, therefore reward awarded by totem changes after a certain time wave.
 Added possibility for thunderstorms. Thunder may light up the world for a few seconds.
 Day and night cycles play different audio now.
 Added consumable maggots.
 Added maggots cooking recipes.
 Added Localization support for Mission and stat pages.
 Added animal trap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/f39d89fca1fb3bd76e9f2f725cdf79d4c09a2fb1.jpg
Recipe can be researched or found through shelves.
Crafting requires a table saw.
Traps can be placed only on grass areas. When there are no animals found in 10 minutes, a certain resource is generated into the trap automatically.
Some animals may attack those traps.
Trap works also as a lure, meaning if deer will see it, it will start moving towards it.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Campfire V1 mesh was changed.
 re-created raining system.
 Asset optimization, should reduce a bit overall package size, before package compress can be enabled.
 Increased night Moonlight intensity.
[/olist]

Bugs
[olist]
 Sulfur orb particles weren't destroyed after they were executed once.
 After upgrading the campfire, it was not possible to burn wood for charcoal.
 Rain drops sound wasn't included in the effects volume channel.
 Upgrading buildparts with storage, destroyed all items which previous level contained.
 Fixed Hologram material, its backside reflected a huge amount of emissive light.
 Fixed outpost roofs, should not leak water any more.
 Ai got stuck at the outpost hologram table.
 Ground decals applied to AI.
 AI didn't attack players if they were standing in the middle of an outpost window frame.
 Keybind saves didn't work in packaged games.
 Canned beets short name was incorrect.
 It Was not possible to cook zombie meat at an upgraded campfire.
 Was possible to walk through certain mountains on the north side of the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.15
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Added pickup animation for small world items.
 Added animations for intractable bush / tree harvesting.
 Added equip & unequip sounds for armor clothing.
 Added rings crafting, rings may give extra quick slots and/ or extra inventory space.
Silver and gold rings require level 2 crafting benches or higher.
Rings have a custom inventory system, they may have up to 4 extra slots, but it's allowed to store items with 1x1 grid only.
 Minimap displays player rotation.
 Added Relic challenge. Interacting with Unknown totems, will spawn 1+n amount of enemy waves (new weave is spawned after the previous one is defeated), defeating a wave, will award you a rare or higher grade item (relic item). (demo test)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/18793ee091ef04b87859c14f061eb18a5bd44b61.jpg
 Added 1 new small ruins POI.
 Added 1 new large ruins POI.
[/olist]


Changes
[olist]
 Improved axe hit detection.
 New game interface displays info now regarding Auto save and auto save interval timer (tooltip).
 Players can walk off the ledges when crouching now.
 Removed crafting, equipment, stats button tooltips as they duplicated button text.
 Flashlight light intensity was reduced, the same amount of light is casted from flashlight, just isn't that bright at close range any more.
 Reduced the amount of fixed food players may get from starting chests. Instead of 3 meals ready to eat, there is only 1.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Correct player will gain experience in multiplayer mode.
 Harvesting large stones / wood gave invalid amount of exp.
 Leather shoulder guards were missing sound effects.
 Fiber and belted skirts didn't play inventory item move sound effects.
 Added a lot of missing physical materials (physical material is configuration, which will determine played sound and particle effect on impact)
 Bio fuel had obsolete inventory action, which just consumed it.
 Ranged weapons didn't deal damage, Were broken with last update.
 Rain particles were rendered through the roof.
 Sulfur orb physics was bugged, on throw orbs rolled forever.
 Loading save game, destroyed some world objects (food storage chests, campfires)
 Removed walk speed debug settings.
 Holding sulfur orb, played duplicate footstep sound.
 Sulfur orbs didn't display damage values
 Re-created one large tree type collision, at certain angles it was possible to get stuck into it.
 Menu button was active if the user was at quest log screen.
 Re-created Anastassia hair shaders, previously they reflected too much light.
 Spotlights casted light at the front of the bulb, not at the bulb.
 Spotlights light intensity was multiplied if they were turned off and on.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.14
notes.notes:
New features.

[olist]
 Possible to craft Wooden spikes.
Wooden spikes can be upgraded into reinforced wooden spikes.
Killing AI with Static defense items (Wooden spikes), won't reward players with experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/0bb8cf7cbd5e3da2ca28c09b0a66c37acad8f952.png
Wooden spikes recipe is added for new gameplay by default. For existing save games, Wood spikes recipe books must be found.

 Experience sharing system. Exp is distributed now to the player, depending on % of damage dealt to the target.
 Roaming AI bugs found at ruins & world, may attack players now, when the player is trying to walk over them and bugs get annoyed by it.
 Possible to raise and lower Build parts for better fit on landscape.
 Placing build parts, displays now Info widget with keybinds, what user can do with that build part.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39266443/f6180c6fcd708fb8a93efc935ba2c8ade5321155.png
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 AI pathfinding allows defining items, over which they will always climb.
 Changes in build part placement detection. Allows to configure, which build parts can be stacked on top of each other and which not.
 Improved Bugs performance.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 The Tree Sap drag image was too large.
 It Was possible to stack lamps on top of each other.
 Healium berries drink didn't give an empty bottle back after all uses were consumed.
 Healium berries drink didn't play the drink sound if used.
 One outpost had non interactable shelves
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.13
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Separate lighting system for day and night.
Previous lighting system shared settings for day and night, therefore it was not possible to tweak night settings, without impacting day lighting.
Now night and day can be configured separately.
 Added Shelf which can be searched and looted. Provides fixed 3 Old paper and / or dynamic loot as 1-9 extra Old paper or a research book.
 Added Servers (broken Server and server rack) which can be searched and looted. Provides fixed Electronic and mechanical parts and / or dynamic loot as springs and extra Electronic and mechanical parts
 Added Sofas, which can be destroyed, destroyed sofas may drop animal leather(s), spring(s). 
Destroying Large sofa, drops Min 4 animal leather and / or dynamic loot 1-2 extra animal leather or 1-4 spring.
Destroying sofa, drops Min 2 animal leather and / or dynamic loot 1-2 extra animal leather or 1-4 spring.

 New Random loot categorization system. 
Previously it was possible to define high level categories for AI / loot storage , like (drop resource, drop consumable etc..). Now can define also specified items with range

Example:
10% drop 1 Spring, 10% 1 - 5 Spring, 25% drop Old Paper.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Deer AI always gives raw meat and animal leather through regular looting.
Extra Meat, leather, animal fat can be harvested with Knife.
 New Night light system should brighten up nights a bit.
 Added a lot more berries on the map, near ruins.
 Player auto save is executed after every 5 minutes now. (will be player configured in the future)
 Extended Large outpost 2nd floor.
 AI won't drop any more every resource, instead certain dynamic and fixed loot is defined per AI.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Re-created Driftwood collisions, as it was possible to get stuck into driftwood.
 Eating consumable item through world action if it was dropped, won't consume full stack any more
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.12
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Added quick split for stacked items. When dragging an item, hold down Shift to quickly split stack.
 Added sounds when moving items around at inventory.
 Added sounds when crafting items at inventory.
 Upgrade research bench. (3 levels) -  All unique meshes to distinguish station level.
 Upgrade workbench (4 levels) - All unique meshes to distinguish station level.
[/olist]

New backpack types added.
[olist]
 Small leather backpack - Up to 24 inventory slots (Epic grade).
 Leather Rucksack -  Up to 32 inventory slots (Epic grade).
[/olist]

New crafting recipes
[olist]
 Piece of plastic
 Charcoal - burn logs or driftwood at campfire.
 Flashlight
 Biofuel
 Smelt iron bars into scrap iron.
 Shredder (Possible to recycle items at Shredder). Requires Biofuel to run.
 Table Saw - Alternative for player inventory carpentry crafting.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Consuming canned food, returns empty can now.
 Changed Workbench Mesh
 Changed Research Bench mesh.
 Moved House build parts from crafting bench to Table Saw.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Meal ready to eat, short names were the same always.
 In game quest log overlapped with in game menu.
 Workbench Build Parts and Consumables button state image was broken.
 Was not possible to drop starting edible resources.
 The Placing Research Bench was broken.
 Fixed Crafting bench and research bench inventory and crafting images.
 Fixed Build part inventory grade colors.
[/olist]

Optimizations
[olist]
 Crafting menu listing was refactored, to support tooltips localization and reduced boiler plate code.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.11
notes.notes:
This patch focuses mostly on optimization. Currently it's planned to release at least one patch which focuses on optimization at least once in a 60 days time frame.

Changes
[olist]
 Revamped Ore Mine starting location.
 Revamped Sapphirium/Silver cave mine.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 was possible to 'Hold' items directly from workbench storage.
 One energy powered warp gate didn't teleport the player to the destination.
 Trees blocked sometimes player capsule movement.
 AI Skeletal hitboxes had invalid mapping. Hitting the head, causes body, not head damage.
[/olist]

Optimization
[olist]
 Grass Debris  triangels/ vertices improvement, should have no visible changes.
 Grass Fern got triangels/ vertices improvement, should have no visible changes.
 Mountains got  triangels/ vertices improvement, should have no visible changes.
 All outposts props got triangels/ vertices improvement, should have no visible changes.
 Small rocks got shadows and triangels/ vertices improvement, should have no visible changes.
 Small trees got triangels/ vertices improvement, if mesh pop-in happens, will revert it back.
 Grass Debris got shadows rendering improvement.
 Small rocks got shadows rendering  improvement.
 Small rocks collision channels were removed as there is no need to calculate collision on such a small object.
 Starting large temple draw calls were reduced by 40%
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.10
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Items crafted at player inventory, display now messages when crafting is completed.
 Added support for missions which require item equipping.
 New mission added which introduces players into graded items and provides a weapon.
 Possible to find Rib cage at ruin areas.
Rib cages can be broken into smaller bones when right clicking on it.
 Added bones, rib cage into random resource spawner list.
 Added Wood torch, Large wood torch crafting.
 Regular Torch can be crafted at player inventory, where a Large wood torch will require workbench.
 Added inventory keybind at HUD.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Increased Common Wooden spiked club crafting %.
 Reduced regular wood and stone drop rate from random item spawner.
 Changed inventory HUD buttons layout.
 Added some extra brain cells for decaying roamers,  previously they often just stared at players, without knowing what to do.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Mission keybind wasn't updated at hud after keybind change.
 It Was not possible to Hold Junk quality wooden spiked clubs directly from inventory.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.9
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Minimap marker is automatically removed if the user is closer than 5m to the target which was set.
 Added Sap into tree loot list.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Balancing changes to all crafting recipes. Previously to survive horde waves, players were forced to rush build and know where static resource locations were.
 New crafting time calculation logic. Item crafting time is calculated based on the amount of items used in the recipe.
 New light profile created for wooden lamp, Unreal engine default lights logic, caused shadow artifacts.
 Optimized small lights, should be available to place more lights at the same location without performance drop.
 Small canteen crafting requires metal scrap now.
 Improved Minimap waypoint targeting.
 Minimap is now automatically zoomed in at player location.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Female walkers didn't have physical material.
 Wood foundation stairs didn't have physical material.
 The Wood lamp had shadow artifacts.
 Fixed item stacking issue, when dragging items from dead bodies.
 Typo on trees code, re-spawned trees too fast.
 The Minimap waypoint wasn't rendered on ground level.
 Attack Wave warning ambient is playing now until wave attacks.
 Double harvesting messages were shown sometimes.
 Wasn't possible to craft Reinforced Leather Shoulder Guard.
 Consumable item grade colors and statuses were invalid.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.8
notes.notes:
New features
[olist]
 Added electronic part crafting under the workbench (by default for new players, existing players have to find a recipe book)
 7 New missions have been added.
Regarding work bench building  (Main quest line).
Find map mission (Main quest line).
Research bench quest line (Main quest line)
Fortify own outpost to stone mission (Main quest line)
Fiber bed crafting mission (Secondary quest line).
Berries harvesting mission (Secondary quest line).
Metallurgy mission (secondary quest line)
 Added support for repair / upgrade quests.
  Added area hazard notifications based on player level - Zone level. When the player wanders to an area where there are more aggressive enemies (Yellow or Red notification.) is shown.
  New player start location added.
  New Iron mine POI added.
  New Outpost POI added.
  New fallen ruin POI added.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Improved Game starting performance, game (data streaming) should be faster.
 New quest markers, easier to identify the quest type which you are dealing with (Main quest vs secondary quest)
 Changed quest line, added find map quest after find outpost.
 Added window frames, door frames into quest 'Walls' listing.
 Added foundation stairs, wood lamp, roof requirement (either wood roof or wood floor contributes to progression) into house building missions.
 Moved wood roof under research table, cause roof sides require triangle walls, which knowledge can be obtained from research table or found from bookshelves.
 Improved AI spawning logic. Should find more often Ai-s now in the open world.
 Optimized spotlights, removed shadows casting, where it made almost no difference.
 Reduced large water canteen drop rate.
 Reduced scrap pipe rifle learning cost by 50%.
 Improved AI pathing through doors and window frames.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Mission target icons were rendered on the ground height.
 Wood lamp pickup with hammer destroyed it.
 Wood Floor Name was incorrect
 Camera collided with Wooden lamps.
 Target warp gates didn't play audio on activation.
 Holding flashlight and jumping, didn't play player jump sound.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch #V 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Fixes
Bed respawn point UI wasn't removed on time, causing issues if it was built inside of the house.

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.6
notes.notes:
NB: Any save game which have more than 1 hour of game time, will get attacked instantly by horde wave.

New Features
[olist]
 Upgrade Campfire to get access for more advanced cooking recipes. (requires Asteroidium stone)
 Can gather water with canteens, bottles, empty cans, empty bowls now.
 New player statistic values added
Ambush waves cleared - How many waves the player has cleared fully.
Last ambush time. - Time when the Horde wave was spawned previously.
 World event - Horde attacks


 After every 60 minutes real world time, the Horde wave will attack the player location.
 Horde AI will spawn randomly near player in 400m radius
 Horde will target players first, if player isn't seen, player buildings are targeted.
 Horde AI will give 3x more exp than regular world AI (currently).
 6 minutes before the horde will attack, world ambient sound changes.

Image of horde wave
 Horde Wave 


[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Improved roamers target detection.
 Revamped water gathering logic, now can harvest water with any item, which can hold liquids.
 Replaced existing WRP-2034 water nodes with central one, all water nodes share same core logic now.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Roamer AI can now jump down if they climbed somewhere.
 Roamer AI makes sound if they are near a player
 Added missing wood build part physical materials.
 Fixed wooden triangle wall R upgraded to stone.
 Fixed Wood window frame upgrade to stone.
 Fixed a small wall upgrade from stone to metal.
 Fixed error on load save game
 Fixed death bags inventory details not updating correctly.
 Fixed issue with storage UI not updating correctly.
 Fixed storage inventories not loading correct
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.5
notes.notes:
NB:
[olist]
 Old save games don't have new crafting recipes which are available by default on new gameplay.
 Old save games may not have new resource storages as files were saved without such information. (can be improved but depends on feedback if it's an issue at all.)
[/olist]

New features

[olist]
 Deer AI can now attack and flee based on its health %.
 Can interact with Trash cans, which can be found at an outpost, to search for 'Loot'.
 Rusty pistol has been added, possible to find it from weapon containers or craft by default.
Rusty pistol supports chambering reload, meaning you can use it without a magazine.
 Added 9mm Sulfur based ammo.
 Added Pistol magazines.
 Added projectile velocity logic, now bullets won't travel on a straight line always, but velocity depends on 'gun powder' used during ammo crafting.
 Added 2 new types of resource containers, which can be found at Survival outposts.
 Added Radio V1, it can be found at certain survival outposts.
 Added 4 new Survival outposts. Contains basic campfire, Workbench (at certain location) , Dynamic lights (Active at night), possible to find some equipment or resource containers near it.

Image of survival outpost
 Survival outpost 

 Added sound for harvesting berries
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 30% of Deers can be hostile towards players.
 Improved items spawning logic.
 Added Junk flashlights into the trash can loot list.
 Changed 7.62x39mm ammo name to S 7.62x39mm , to define it's Sulfur based ammo
 Increased sunlight time length at WRP-2034.
 Changed dynamic day start time, certain world lights work based on that timeframe. 
Old: from 6 am to 8 pm,
New: from 7 am to 10 pm.
 Increased regular Wood burning time from 10 seconds per log to 30 seconds per log.
 Increased Driftwood burning time from 10 seconds per log to 60 seconds per log.
 Increased Pipe rifles durability.
 Pipe rifles can now  be repaired near the Crafting bench.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Empty Bottle had invalid Inventory image
 Empty Bottle had invalid Inventory size, was 1x1 grid, supposed to be 1x2 grids
 Empty Can had invalid Inventory size, was 1x1 grid, supposed to be 1x2 grids
 Fixed duplicate equipped items after loading the saved game.
 Wasn't possible to repair axes/ pickaxes other than Junk grade.
 Was not possible to fix Scrap weapons, but durability was reduced.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Changes
[olist]
 Items can be equipped from backpack / pockets, no need to attach them into primary and / or secondary slot every time.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Was not possible to smelt Gold ores at furnace.
 User was as tilted state after respawn, if respawn point was placed on a slope.
 Items - Silver, Gold bar had incorrect inventory Images.
 Item - world map had invalid inventory image.
 Removed testing fiber bed, at temple.
 Fixed graded pickaxes. Previously all pickaxes harvested as Junk grade one.

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New Features
[olist]
 Added new world map logic.
 Added waypoints logic, players can now mark waypoints on the map.

How To:
Find world map.
If Map is opened, click on a map to add Waypoint.

 Possible to cook Decayed meat on campfire
[/olist]

Changes

[olist]
 New shadows cascading logic (Please notify if there is huge negative Frames per second impact, compared to previous build)
Apples to apples comparison
 Old Shadows 
 New Shadows 
 Previously it was expected that players can see world map only if they find one. Now World map can be obtained from info booths, which may be found at outposts.
Image of info booth:
 Info booth

 Reduced tier 1 enemies health by 20-40% (Slow crawlers/ walkers / Deer)
 As Monster exp reward is tied to health stat (currently) Tier 1 enemies give 20-40% less exp if they are killed.
 Fiber bed crafting requires 50% less resources.
 Basic bandage crafting requires 50% less resources.
[/olist]

Fixes 

[olist]
 Cave Zombie Roamers spawned sometimes without any harvestable loot.
 Player map wasn't closed if it was open during death.
 Was possible to open map when inventory or mission HUD was open.
 Was possible to fall through ground on respawn.
 Infinite water was provided by large water bottle.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.2
notes.notes:
New Features
[olist]
 Allied AI Weapons vendor has been added, who buys and sells certain graded weapons.
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 New light profile added for flashlight
 Uncommon and Rare foliage is spawned now into certain Ruins.
 Cause starting position is picked randomly for players, some areas had less activity.
Added 2 outposts and 3 ruin areas
Added 3 water fountain areas
Added more Fixed AI spawns.
 Light weapons won't stun AI 100% any more. Previously was possible to cancel AI attacks always if attacked them on right time.
 Increased Harder AI spawn speed. Runners and Hunters may be encountered more often than before.
[/olist]

Fixes
[olist]
 Foliage Generation was broken, some locations were empty / missing trees and resources.
 Animal Leather has incorrect image.
 AI ignores other AI occupied navigation data location, therefore they should not collide with each other any more.
 Flashlight blinded user if it was used in fog.
 One outpost wasn't included into quest progression.
 Fixed Civilian Mesh loading error.
 Resource item Cartridge & Bullet Tip were missing Allow stacking logic.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch #V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changes
[olist]
 Starting pockets size increased from 24 to 40 slots.
 Crafted pockets size per grade increased by x2.
 Changed sun northern latitude from 32 to 20, therefore sun rotates now higher and won't be blocked that often by mountains, should cause less darkness during daytime.

 Game launching as VR by default if Oculus or Steam VR were connected.
